userStories.title: Stop reading the acceptance section
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Stop all production reads/writes of the acceptance config section while keeping its schema/default available until US-003.

**Motivation** — `applyWorkflowMode` forces `acceptance.enabled` to `false`, so every remaining reader reads a constant or reads nothing.

**Approach** — Part 1: stop reading `acceptance` (US-001)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `config/workflow-mode.ts` | the acceptance term, its spread and its comment go; `storyIsolation` stays until US-004 |
| `run-initialization.ts` `runWillUseAgent` and its doc comment | target shape above; the doc comment's acceptance-loop sentence goes |
| `cli/advisor-import.ts` | target shape above |
| `cli/init-detect.ts` | target shape above |
| `config/merge.ts` | the `acceptance` merge block (`:189-196`), the `packageOverride.acceptance != null` term (`:78`) and the doc line (`:59`) go |
| `precheck/checks-model-resolution-walk.ts` | the `acceptance.model` pin (`:276-279`) and its mention in the `:252` comment go |
| `config/selectors.ts` | `"acceptance"` leaves the `PrecheckConfig` pick list |
| `config/runtime-types.ts` | `NaxConfig.acceptance` becomes optional |

`test/unit/runtime/packages-workflow.test.ts` (it only asserts acceptance is forced off per package), `test/unit/config/acceptance-fix-config.test.ts` and `test/unit/config/acceptance-test-strategy.test.ts` (they only test the acceptance schemas) are deleted.

Target integration notes: `runWillUseAgent(prd: PRD): boolean`, true when any story is not `"passed"`. The skip log reads `Skipping agent preflight — no story needs work`. `AdvisorImportDeps` has no `acceptanceEnabled`; `toQuestion(r, f, sha, deps)` passes `acceptanceEnabledForStory: false` to `buildMenu`. `buildInitConfig(stack)` returns `{ version: 1 }` when the stack is undetected or has no quality commands, else `{ version: 1, quality: { commands } }`. `buildAcceptanceConfig` is deleted. `NaxConfig.acceptance` is optional after US-001; removed with `AcceptanceConfig`, `AcceptanceFixConfig` and `AcceptanceTestStrategy` in US-003.

**Scope** — In: the Part 1 readers/writer, optional field, mixed-test trimming and fixture changes below. Out: US-002's remaining fixture sweep and refusal messages, US-003's schema/default/type/description deletion and strip entry, and US-004's storyIsolation normalization removal. The advisor's `acceptanceEnabledForStory` parameter and its branch in `advisor/menus.ts`: constant `false` after US-001, but removing it is an advisor-menu change; it is appended to #2823.

**Interface** — `runWillUseAgent(prd: PRD): boolean`; `toQuestion(r, f, sha, deps)`; `buildInitConfig(stack)`; `NaxConfig.acceptance` changes from `acceptance: AcceptanceConfig` to optional. `applyWorkflowMode(config: NaxConfig, warn: (msg: string) => void): NaxConfig` keeps its current signature and storyIsolation behavior in this story. No new exported symbol is introduced.

In advisor-import tests remove the harness dep and assert menus using false. In init-detect-ui keep stack detection and replace acceptance-section describes with AC4/AC5. In defaults stop expecting forced-off acceptance, but keep the schema's section until US-003. In merge delete the acceptance override describe and its root-immutability case; keep all other section cases. In workflow normalization retain advisor and storyIsolation cases until US-004. In run-initialization remove the acceptance-enabled preflight case and initWith acceptance option, drop its fixture section, and pin both preflight outcomes. Delete only the acceptance package override case in effective-config. Remove acceptance from the expected PrecheckConfig keys. Temporarily use `config.acceptance ?? {}` in generateTests no-op tests. Drop acceptance overrides in the two execution integration fixtures and state-handoff fixture. Delete the acceptance.model row in the never-shipped-model precheck table.

Verification — every story runs in order and leaves a tree that compiles and passes the suite. Run these four steps in packages/nax:
1. `bun run typecheck`. A removed key, field, parameter or export that is still referenced fails here, including in test fixtures that build a `NaxConfig` literal.
2. A string sweep: for each removed key, `rg -n -w '<leaf>' src bin scripts test`; for each removed function, constant, type and file, `rg -n -w '<name>' src bin scripts test`. This story's sweep names: `buildAcceptanceConfig`, `acceptanceEnabled`, `acceptanceOn`. Also read the hits of `rg -n 'acceptance' src/config/workflow-mode.ts src/config/merge.ts src/execution/lifecycle/run-initialization.ts src/cli/advisor-import.ts src/cli/init-detect.ts src/precheck/checks-model-resolution-walk.ts src/config/selectors.ts`. Expected remaining hits: `acceptanceEnabledForStory` in cli/advisor-import.ts (the literal false) and advisor/ (Out of Scope); `cc-acceptance` in a config/selectors.ts comment, a profile name (different concept); `acceptanceEnabled` as the makeConfig parameter in test/unit/execution/runner-completion-finish.test.ts, runner-completion-postrun.test.ts and runner-completion-skip.test.ts (removed in US-003); none in the other files read above. Expected result: only these remaining hits, else stop. A sweep scoped to files is read only in those files. A hit of the same word naming a different concept (a profile name such as cc-acceptance, the acceptance stage name, finish.timeouts.acceptanceMs, a test-strategy value) is left alone. A hit in code is a missed reference; a hit in a comment is a stale comment and is reworded, in any file, with no Modifies entry needed; a hit naming a different concept is listed, not changed. Locate sites by symbol, not baseline line numbers.
3. `bun run check:complexity:update`, and `bun run check:file-sizes -- --update-baseline` when that check reports a lowerable entry. After `check:all` is green, `bun run check:test-escape-hatches:update` lowers the escape-hatch totals the deleted tests carried.
4. `bun run check:all` and `bun run test`.

A test that mixes removed and kept behaviour is trimmed, so the kept assertions stay. A fixture that sets a removed key drops that key. userStories.description:
**Goal** — Drop acceptance from the designated fixtures and stop naming acceptance.command in nax config-write refusals without changing permission enforcement.

**Motivation** — The other leaves have no reader.

**Approach** — Part 2: drop `acceptance` from fixtures and the refusal text (US-002)

 `"is nax configuration; only Read, Grep and Glob may open it, and no tool may modify it. " +`
 `"`quality.commands` run through a shell without passing the permission gate, " +`
 `"so editing this file could run an ungated command on the next run."`.
- The config-file reason in `agents/nax-owned-writes.ts:357-362` becomes
 `"is one of nax's own config files, which every tool is refused regardless of grant -- " +`
 `"`quality.commands` are run through a shell WITHOUT passing the " +`
 `"permission gate because a human wrote them, so editing this file is a route to running " +`
 `"an ungated command on the next run"`. Its `:119` doc comment drops `acceptance.command` too.
- The two tests that pin those strings follow.

**Scope** — In: the exact two refusal strings, their pinned expected reasons, and the 19 fixture cleanups below. Out: US-003's removal of acceptance schemas/types/defaults/descriptions and removed-key strip entry. userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the acceptance config surface and migrate historical sections through the shared loader warning/strip mechanism.

**Motivation** — `src/acceptance/` was removed in B2a (#2813).

**Approach** — Part 3: remove the `acceptance` section (US-003)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `config/schemas-infra.ts` `AcceptanceFixConfigSchema`, `AcceptanceConfigSchema` | deleted |
| `config/schemas.ts` | the `acceptance` default, the import and the re-export go |
| `config/schema.ts`, `config/types.ts`, `config/index.ts` | their acceptance type and schema re-exports go |
| `config/runtime-types.ts` | `AcceptanceConfig`, `AcceptanceFixConfig`, `AcceptanceTestStrategy` and `NaxConfig.acceptance` go |
| `cli/config-descriptions.ts` | the `acceptance` and `acceptance.*` entries go |
| `config/config-guards.ts` `REMOVED_NO_OP_KEYS` | the `acceptance.generateTests` entry goes: the section entry covers it |
| `config/removed-config-keys.ts` | gains `"acceptance": PIPELINE_ONLY_KEY_HINT` |

`test/unit/cli/acceptance-config-descriptions.test.ts` is deleted. The section's leaves were all pipeline-only: the acceptance phase was removed with pipeline mode, so `PIPELINE_ONLY_KEY_HINT` is accurate.

Timing constraint. `loadConfig` starts from `structuredClone(DEFAULT_CONFIG)` (`config/loader.ts`), and `DEFAULT_CONFIG` is `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`. If a key is added to `REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS` while the schema still defaults it, every load warns. So US-003 and US-006 add each strip entry in the same change that removes that key's schema field and default.

A config sets `acceptance` or any leaf under it: config loads; the section is dropped before `safeParse`; one warning naming `acceptance`. A config sets `acceptance.generateTests` now warns as part of the `acceptance` section, not under its own name. `nax config` and `nax config --explain` no longer list the removed keys. The default config (no project file) loads with no `has been removed` warning.

**Scope** — In: schema/default/types/barrels/descriptions/no-op-map cleanup, acceptance strip entry, remaining fixtures, and loader/CLI regression pins. Out: US-004's worktree branches, US-005's deleted modules/category, and US-006's execution schema keys, shim and strip entries. `finish.timeouts.acceptanceMs`, the `AcceptanceFact` finish type and the `acceptance` context stage name in `stage-config.ts`: different concepts with the same word. `acceptance` as a permission stage in `test/unit/config/inert-bash-stages.test.ts`: it tests the B3b removed-stage strip, a different vocabulary.

**Interface** — `REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS` gains `"acceptance": PIPELINE_ONLY_KEY_HINT`; `PIPELINE_ONLY_KEY_HINT` is `"nothing reads this key since pipeline mode was removed"`. The exact warning is `Config key "acceptance" has been removed — nothing reads this key since pipeline mode was removed. Remove it from your config.` `loadConfig` takes no warn parameter: in the ACs, warns means the loader's warning reaches a logger sink registered with addSink, as test/unit/config/removed-stage-names.test.ts captures it. Reuse stripRemovedConfig at all three existing loader strip sites before NaxConfigSchema.safeParse. A section entry strips the whole section with one warning. No new exported symbol is introduced.
